verdict.rationale: Bento is an agent observability SaaS with authenticated CLI and ingest endpoints, so scoped credentials are a fair axis. The evidence only shows a browser-based CLI login that saves tokens to the keychain and a single auth header for OTel export. Nothing documents issuing scoped, least-privilege, or per-agent API keys, which is an adjacent capability at most.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
